<b>Penitents</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Slab Penitents#The Penitents|prisoners]] in [[the Slab]] who are serving their sentence for sin committed within [[the Citadel]].<ref>Penitent [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Humbled prisoner serving their sentence for sin committed within the Citadel."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Penitents do not move outside of attacking, and attack as soon as Hornet is in their vicinity. To attack, Penitents lunge at Hornet, sliding on the ground for a moment before stopping.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Chastise us... o shame!
* Shame! Shame!
* Punish us... cleanse us...
* Holy silence... swallow our shame...
}}

== Location ==
Penitents can be found in [[the Slab]].
